findings.requirement: Search matches partial queries across every user-visible work-item field.
findings.behavior: Search now requires the combined searchable text to begin with the query, so substrings and values in later fields do not match.
findings.impact: Users cannot find items using partial names, summaries, or tags unless the query happens to be a prefix of the item's name.
findings.reproduction: Create an item named "Alpha Review" and search for "pha"; the item is excluded. Searching for one of its tags is also excluded because the joined text begins with the name.
findings.recommendation: Normalize the trimmed query and use `.includes(...)` against the combined searchable fields.

findings.requirement: Search matches partial queries across every user-visible work-item field.
findings.behavior: The owner and note fields were removed from the searchable field list.
findings.impact: Items cannot be discovered using visible owner or note text.
findings.reproduction: Create an item whose owner is "Priya" and whose other fields do not contain that text, then search for "Priya"; the item is excluded.
findings.recommendation: Restore `item.owner` and `item.note` to the searchable field list and retain partial matching.

findings.requirement: A specific status selection includes only that workflow status.
findings.behavior: Every specific status selection returns all non-blocked items instead of comparing each item with the selected status.
findings.impact: Status-filtered results include unrelated workflow statuses, while selecting Blocked excludes blocked items entirely.
findings.reproduction: Filter a list containing Open, Escalated, and Blocked items with status "Escalated"; both Open and Escalated items pass. Select "Blocked" and only the non-blocked items pass.

findings.requirement: Risk scoring preserves due-today urgency and blocked-item weighting.
findings.behavior: Due-today items receive the same 12-point urgency as items due in one or two days, replacing the dedicated 24-point due-today boost.
findings.impact: Due-today work can receive materially lower risk scores and lose its intended priority in the queue.
findings.reproduction: For otherwise identical items due in 0, 1, and 2 days, `calculateRisk` now adds 12 urgency points to each; previously the due-today item received 24.
findings.recommendation: Preserve a distinct due-today branch with its existing urgency weight, then apply the declining calculation to later due dates.

findings.requirement: Risk scoring preserves due-today urgency and blocked-item weighting.
findings.behavior: Blocked items receive no status weight, and the prior blocked/escalated weight of 18 was reduced and restricted to escalated items.
findings.impact: Blocked work is under-scored and may be ranked below otherwise equivalent unblocked work.
findings.reproduction: Compare two otherwise identical items where one is Open and one is Blocked; both now receive a status penalty of 0.
findings.recommendation: Include both Blocked and Escalated statuses in the weighted branch and preserve the required blocked-item weight.

findings.requirement: Summary metrics count both blocked and escalated work.
findings.behavior: The summary's blocked count includes escalated items only and excludes items whose status is Blocked.
findings.impact: Portfolio metrics underreport obstructed work and can show zero despite blocked items being present.
findings.reproduction: Call `summarizePortfolio` with one Blocked item and no Escalated items; the returned blocked count is 0.
findings.recommendation: Count items whose status is either `Blocked` or `Escalated`.

findings.requirement: The queue shows every matching item unless pagination is explicitly introduced.
findings.behavior: The queue silently limits rendering to the first five items without adding pagination or another way to access the remainder.
findings.impact: Matching items after the fifth position disappear from the user-visible queue.
findings.reproduction: Pass six matching items to `WorkQueue`; only the first five buttons are rendered.
findings.recommendation: Render all supplied items, or introduce explicit pagination with controls and item-count feedback.
